title: Keep disabled Engram path silent for project-less delegations
outcome: The delegated-dispatch Engram path resolves a project before checking whether Engram is enabled. A delegation whose parent is not attached to a project can therefore emit an engram> diagnostic even when Engram is disabled everywhere, violating the S0 no-op letter.
acceptance: With Engram disabled, project-less delegated dispatch performs no Engram request, persists no Engram fields, and emits no Engram diagnostic; focused coverage exercises the project-less parent path.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 batch 10f6b1ad, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. A projectless delegation returns disabled without a diagnostic (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:6339), with a dedicated regression at src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs:449. Closed by evidence; no formal acceptance evaluation was run.
